Def.label: Just capture in the ball
Def.description: Capture the pawn into the sphere without changing its status.

Def.label: Imprison (humanlikes; animals get tamed)
Def.description: Capture the pawn and make it a prisoner (animals are tamed instead).

Def.label: Capture and enslaved/tamed (recruit fallback)
Def.description: Capture and tame animals or enslave humanlikes. Without Ideology, humanlikes are recruited instead.

Def.label: Convert to player faction
Def.description: Capture the pawn and convert it to the capturing faction.
